items.name: Squid Boost
items.author: Samuel
items.description: Smoother play in busy places: skips drawing far-away dropped items, XP orbs, chests and signs. Works with resource-pack shaders.

items.name: Compass
items.author: Samuel
items.description: A compass bar at the top of the screen that shows which way you're facing.

items.name: Fullbright
items.author: Samuel
items.description: Press B to see in the dark, like night vision without the potion. Change the key in Controls.

items.name: Minimap
items.author: Samuel
items.description: A map of the world around you in the top-left corner. C makes it bigger, M opens the full map. Inspired by Xaero's Minimap.

items.name: X-Ray
items.author: Samuel
items.description: Press X to see ores through the ground. Many servers count this as cheating, so it's best in single player.

items.name: Zoom
items.author: Samuel
items.description: Hold Z to zoom in like a spyglass. Change the key in Controls.
